figurative_meaning_en: Wearing only one piece of cloth; just a dhoti; state without an upper garment
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে একছুটে ঘর থেকে বেরিয়ে এল, শুধু ধুতি পরে।
অতি তাড়াহুড়োয় একছুট অবস্থায় চলে গেল।
example_sentences_in_english: He rushed out of the house half-dressed, wearing only his dhoti.
In great haste, he left in a state of wearing just one cloth.
note: Implies rushing out in incomplete traditional attire, common in rural Bengali contexts.
